entry.title: 2026 nî peh--gue̍h
entry.content:
Jī khòng jī lio̍k nî peh--gue̍h ê gue̍h-tsì.

2026-08-22

  • Bāng-lōo sûn tshân-tsuí, khuànn-tio̍h tsi̍t-phinn lūn-bûn leh kóng Hàn-gí hē-thóng lāi-tē ê tsìn-hîng-thé (progressive aspect), m̄-koh bô khǹg Bân-gí (閩語) ê gí-liāu, m̄-tsai sī-án-tsuánn.

    Lu, Wen & Giorgio Francesco Arcodia. 2026. Towards a typology of progressive aspect marking in Sinitic: a pilot study. Folia Linguistica 1–52. https://doi.org/10.1515/flin-2025-0159.

  • Līng-guā tsi̍t-pún sin-ê huan-i̍k-tsheh, Huān-tiân Tsin-kí (飯田真紀) kàu-siū siá--ê, sī leh thó-lūn Kńg-tang-uē ê tē-uī: 廣東話的世界：全球超過八千萬人使用的另一種中文，不被同化、收編的獨特語言. Guá kám-kak kóng ē-tàng tsham Kiat-tiân, Tsin-ngōo (吉田真悟) kàu-siū tshut--ê 台湾語と文字の社会言語学 kap tsò-hué tha̍k.

    飯田真紀. 2026.《廣東話的世界：全球超過八千萬人使用的另一種中文，不被同化、收編的獨特語言》（葉錦龍譯）。新北市：八旗文化。

    吉田真悟. 2023.《台湾語と文字の社会言語学》。東京：三元社。

    Bīn-tsheh tíng-thâu ū tsi̍t-kū uē, khuànn-tio̍h kài sim-sik:

    這本書的作者是日本人，翻譯者是香港人、前中西區石塘咀區議員。你不如想想為什麼這本書會在台灣出版？

2026-08-20

  • Bāng-lōo sûn tshân-tsuí, khuànn-tio̍h Merlin’s Leipzig Gloss Tool 2.0: An Online Tool for Creating Editable Interlinear Glossed Text, īng AI tàu-sann-kāng pang lí tsù-kái. Siāu-kài luē-iông ū kóng-tio̍h tsi-uân Bân-lâm-gí, m̄-koh guá kám-kak kóng tse pang-tsān ing-kai iú-hān, lo̍h-bué put-jû ka-tī phah.

    Tsok-tsiá í-tsá siá--kuè ê līng-guā tsi̍t-thò ke-si-thâu Merlin's Syntax Studio tio̍h kài lī-piān--looh.

  • Khuànn-tio̍h Genealogy - Special Issue: Names and Naming in Contact Situations leh tsio-kó, siōnn-tio̍h í-tsá bat tshú-lí Tâi-uân ū sió-tshing-sû (小稱詞) á ê tē-miâ, tuì gí-giân-ha̍k ê kak-tōo lâi khuànn tsia ê á ū siánn-mihkong-lîng.

2026-08-18

  • Bāng-lōo sûn tshân-tsuí, khuànn-tio̍h iàu-ì ê sin-tsheh: «How to Kill a Language: Power, Resistance, and the Race to Save Our Words», m̄-tsai luē-iông siánn-khuán. Sī-kóng tsit-pún tsheh thài-sin--ê, ài tán āu-kò-gue̍h tsiah thang thui-tsiàn hōo tôo-su-kuán.

    Galer, Sophia Smith. 2026. How to Kill a Language: Power, Resistance, and the Race to Save Our Words. New York: Crown.

    Moniz, Alex De Lusignan Fan. 2021. How to Kill a Language: Planning, Diglossia, Bi-normativism, the Internet... and Galician. European Journal of Applied Linguistics Studies 4(1). 45–73. https://doi.org/10.33774/coe-2021-j359l.

2026-08-16

  • Tiong-tàu-tǹg pûn-tuānn, tsuí-kiáu īng tshue--ê, bô īng sa̍h--ê. Kài-sîng bô sánn thò-tòng, ū-khó-lîng kuí-liap-á tshue bô si̍k, tsia̍h liáu sió-khuá-á làu.

2026-08-15

  • Tsái-khí khì bé pn̄g-uân, thâu-ke gû-ni-tê bô siu-tsînn, kóng beh tshiánn--guá. Pún-té siōnn kóng thàn--tio̍h, lo̍h-bué huat-hiān, thâu-ke kài-sîng jīn-m̄-tio̍h lâng.

2026-08-14

  • Kiàn-pái khuànn-tio̍h huâ-gí kàu-ha̍k nā ū siá Tâi-gí sû, guá lóng tsiânn hònn-hiân, tsia Tâi-gí sû tàu-té sī beh hoo Tâi-gí im, iah-sī Huâ-gí im: 漢字部件的眉眉角角

  • Hiong-káng Tiong-bûn Tāi-ha̍k (香港中文大學) tsîng tsi̍t-tsām-á ū pān tsi̍t-ê thó-lūn gí-giân-ha̍k su̍t-gí (術語) beh án-nuá kui-huān ê lūn-tuânn: 語言學術語論壇. Guá tsai-iánn Tâi-uân í-tsá ū lāu-su bat tsíng-lí--kuè, m̄-koh bô sù-siông huan-sin tio̍h-sī. Līng-guā tsi̍t-kiānn tāi-tsì tio̍h-sī guá kám-kak kóng Tâi-uân gí-giân-ha̍k kî-khan ê bûn-hiàn tsham-khó ài thóng-it tsiah tio̍h, tshin-tshiōnn huat-lu̍t kî-khan án-ne-senn.

2026-08-13

  • Tsái-khí tshuā lāu-pē khì Bô-tsiòng-gāi Hok-lī tsi Ka (無障礙福利之家) hông phîng-koo, khuànn tshíng ū lûn-í í-tsū ê póo-tsōo--bô.

  • ISTLT-16 thong-pò ê tiah-iàu jī-sòo hān-tsè sió-khuá-á kuài-kuài, kóng Ing-bûn mài tshiau-kuè 500 ê “character”, būn-tê sī tse kin-pún tio̍h siá bô kuí jī (word), m̄-tsai ū 100 jī--bô?

    (The full text of the abstract should be 300-500 characters; please do not exceed 500 characters)

2026-08-12

  • Tsái-khí guā-bīn lo̍h-hōo, khì hāng-á-kháu bé pn̄g-uân tńg-lâi tsò tsá-tǹg tsia̍h. Tsit-king pn̄g-uân, guá beh tsia̍h tsìn-tsîng, lóng tio̍h-ài tshut-la̍t kā pn̄g-uân tēnn hōo khah ba̍t--ê, nā-bô lāi-bīn ê iû-tsia̍h-kué sionn-kuè tuā-tè, oh-tit kheh.

  • Tiàm The LINGUIST List bīn-tíng sûn tshân-tsuí, khuànn tio̍h tsi̍t-kuá-á iàu-ì ê siau-sit:

    Tsheh-phîng: Reviews: Research Methods in Linguistics: Lia Litosseliti (ed.) (2024).

    Sin-tsheh: Adverbs and Particles at the Form-Meaning Interface: Coniglio, Müller, and Steinbach (eds.) (2026), Acquisition of Korean: Choi (ed.) (2026), Books: Silent Instruments: Suozzi (2026).

    Gí-liāu-khòo gí-giân-ha̍k: Books: Grammar through the Lens of Corpus Linguistics: Pérez-Guerra, Fernández-Pena, and Martínez-Insua (eds.) (2026), New Frontiers in Corpus Linguistics Symposium (China).

  • Tâi-gí Gián-kiú kî-khan ū tsi̍t-phinn gí-giân kíng-kuan ê lūn-bûn, siōnn-beh tha̍k khuànn-māi--leh.

    張學謙. 2026.〈Cháu-chhōe看會著ê聲音：語言景觀文獻回顧〉。《台語研究》18.1: 4-35。

  • Khuànn SICOL-2026 gián-thó-huē iàu-ì ê tiah-iàu.

    Syntactic and Pragmatic Asymmetries of the Left-Peripheral Discourse Operator Shenme ‘what’ in Mandarin Chinese: From Partial Filtering to Total Blocking (Barry Chung-Yu Yang)

    On the Semantics and Syntax of Taiwanese V kah Exclamatives (Rui-heng Ray Huang)

    Revisiting the A-A’ Distinction in Korean Long-Distance Scrambling (Daniel Plesniak)

    From Declarative to Mood: Semanticizing the Speech-Act Layer of Korean -ta (Mingyeong Choi)

2026-08-11

  • Kīn-lâi tsái-khí thong-siông tshit-tiám tsing-sîn, m̄-koh sô--tsi̍t-ē tsha-put-to ài uá peh-tiám tsiah thang tsia̍h tsá-tǹg, kiám-tshái í-āu mài sô hiah kú, tsiah-buē khì thua tio̍h suà--lo̍h-lâi ài tsò--ê khang-khuè.

  • Ū tsi̍t-hó bô nn̄g-hó. Tsa̋ng tshuē--tio̍h-ê pòo-kíng hexo-theme-shiro, pún-té lia̍h-tsún kóng tàu-liáu Hàn-lô (漢羅) bûn-tsiong khuànn--khí-lâi to suí-suí, siâng tsai-iánn kóng uānn-tsò Tsuân-lô (全羅) suî phuà-kong. Tē-peh-tiāu kui-ê tsáu-tsing--khì.

    Lo̍h-bué pûn-tuānn, tsông-á kā thîng-sik-bé lia̍h--lo̍h-lâi, kā themes\shiro\source\css\_core\base.css, themes\shiro\source\css\_core\tokens.css, themes\shiro\scripts\lib\fonts.js, themes\shiro\source\css\style.min.css lāi-bīn ê jī-thé kui-ê uānn-tsò Hún-înn (粉圓) khah khuì-ua̍h.

  • Kin-á-ji̍t m̄-tsai sī-án-tsuánn jua̍h kah, hip kah, bô khui líng-khì ū-iánn tsàn-buē-tiâu.

  • Khuànn-tio̍h Tionn, Ha̍k-khiam (張學謙) lāu-su kin-á-ji̍t siá--ê siā-lūn: 自由開講》保障母語媒體，修補國家造成的語言傷痕, hōo-guá siōnn-tio̍h Kong-sī Sin-bûn-bāng (公視新聞網) bīn-tíng ê Tâi-gí sin-bûn, í-king m̄-tsai juā-kú bô kuânn-tio̍h tsuân-bûn--looh.

2026-08-10

  • Bô-tionn-tî tshuē-tio̍h hexo-theme-shiro tsit-ê pòo-kíng thang hōo guá ê bāng-tsām tàu.

  • Àm-sî khì pau piān-tong, thàn pâi-tuī the̍h tshiú-ki-á tshut-lâi sûn tiān-tsú-phue, tsiap tio̍h NCL-2026 ê thong-pò, kóng gián-thó-huē tiah-iàu hőng tsiap-siū--ah, sî-kàu ài tsiōnn-tâi huat-piáu.

    Tha̍k-liáu sim-kuann-thâu it-ti̍t tsu-bui--khí-lâi.

  • Tsia̍h-pn̄g-pá khuànn-tio̍h Niú-se-lân (New Zealand) gī-huē tiàm tshit gue̍h sann-tsa̍p sam-tho̍k thong-kuè Ing-gí tsiânn-tsò tsi̍t-tsióng kuann-hong gí-giân ê huat-àn: English Language Act 2026.

    Tsìn-tsîng Niú-se-lân ê huat-tīng kuann-hong gí-giân ū Môo-lī-gí (Māori) kap Niú-se-lân tshiú-gí, tsit-pái tsit-ê huat-àn hōo si̍t-tsè-siōng (de facto) kài-tsē lâng teh kóng ê Ing-gí, pá-kuh ke koh-khah tsāi. M̄-tsai-iánn suà--lo̍h-lâi kám-ē khì siu-sok Môo-lī-gí ê tsu-guân, iáu-koh-ū sú-iōng.

entry.title: 網站起鼓
entry.content:
最近想講來舞一 ê 網站，寫寡 khah 長 ê 文章。

這 ê 網站舊底（差不多十冬前）是用 html 寫--ê，成做個人 ê 網頁簡單仔用。Tiőng 有一段時間，Markdown 語法足 tshìng--ê，向時我 bat 揣看敢有家私頭通 kā Markdown 語法轉做 html，按呢網站資料 teh 翻新會 khah 利便。毋閣家私頭揣規晡，壟蓋夯枷，無我 ê 緣。雖罔我對 Markdown ê 語法蓋熟，但是誠 tsheh 電腦內面鬥一大堆有--ê 無--ê 軟體，落尾總--是貧惰，舊 ê 網站 tsőng-á 放--leh，無閣翻新。

這改趁機會用 Hexo + GitHub Action 做一遍改 hōo 好，我 ê 電腦紲--落來要意 Markdown 檔案就好，git push 了後，網站會自動翻新，免我操煩；上蓋重要 ê 是，我 ê 電腦猶原 iáu-sī 清氣相。抑若文章愛囥 tuà 佗一類、愛結佗一種牽仔（tag），thìng-hó 等我有閒 ê 時陣，才沓沓仔想。

網站號名叫做「Ngōo-giân-koh（悟言閣）」，意思就是用來寫一寡生活體驗、時勢管見，食老才知 ê 代。遮 ê 文章毋知影會當寫偌久，總--是一步一步照起工來，向望有一日，鴨卵會當抾到米斗 tīnn。
